scope: Original GNU, separately lowered C, and Rust Bash entries on bounded shell fixtures, with per-process Valgrind logs including forked children. Complete parent and child summaries are required; native GNU findings remain baseline observations. Full Bash original suites, interactive job control, and loadable builtins remain open.

results.name: variables
args: declare -a a=(alpha beta); declare -A m=([key]=value); printf "%s:%s\n" "${a[1]}" "${m[key]}"

results.name: loops
args: for x in a b c; do if [[ $x == b ]]; then continue; fi; printf "%s\n" "$x"; done

results.name: functions
args: f(){ local x=inner; printf "%s\n" "$x"; return 7; }; x=outer; f; printf "%s:%s\n" "$?" "$x"

results.name: pipeline
args:
printf "alpha
beta
" | while IFS= read -r line; do printf "line:%s
" "$line"; done

results.name: shift
args: set -- one two three; shift; printf "%s:%s\n" "$#" "$1"

results.name: exec-plain-loop
args: for item in one two; do ./plain "$item"; done

results.name: dynamic-assoc-restart
args: alias sample="printf sample"; hash -p /bin/true sample; declare -p BASH_ALIASES BASH_CMDS; ./plain dynamic

results.name: pipeline-three
args:
printf "alpha
beta
" | while read -r x; do printf "%s
" "$x"; done | while read -r x; do printf "last:%s
" "$x"; done

results.name: pipeline-lastpipe
args: shopt -s lastpipe; printf "one\n" | read -r item; printf "%s\n" "$item"
